ResearchProjectDef.label: Mugirl dairy processing
ResearchProjectDef.description: Standardize everyday processing of Mugirl milk: make milk pudding, cheese, plain milk candy and milk cream apples on the stove. Finer products still call for better preservation and pharmaceutical facilities.

ResearchProjectDef.label: Mugirl milk power utilization
ResearchProjectDef.description: Build a dedicated generator that burns Mugirl milk, turning surplus dairy into electrical power. Wiring it into a grid still requires Electricity.

ResearchProjectDef.label: Mugirl advanced dairy
ResearchProjectDef.description: Master the deep processing of Mugirl milk: aged cheese, milk cake, milk powder and milk tablets need refrigerated storage, while baota dewormer candy is prepared at a drug lab.

ResearchProjectDef.label: Mugirl restraints and roping
ResearchProjectDef.description: Master basic Mugirl restraint and roping craft: make sensory, limb and full-body restraints, mount wall rope hitches, and cut medieval and industrial restraint keys.

ResearchProjectDef.label: Mugirl regulated milking
ResearchProjectDef.description: Establish a regulated mechanized milking routine: craft wearable and concealable milking devices for stable, centralized collection.

ResearchProjectDef.label: Mugirl advanced control systems
ResearchProjectDef.description: Develop electronic restraint and psychological control systems: craft shock collars, brainwashing helmets, spacer restraint keys and decryptors, and reproduce corporate-style magnetic shackles.

ResearchProjectDef.label: Mugirl garment tailoring
ResearchProjectDef.description: Establish tailoring for the Mugirl frame: make casual wear, formal dress, occupational uniforms, stockings, underwear and ornaments. Most garments also require Complex clothing.

ResearchProjectDef.label: Mugirl combat attire
ResearchProjectDef.description: Standardize Mugirl combat and PMC gear: battle uniforms, field gear, flak sets, recon helmets and knight plate sized for a Mugirl frame.

ResearchProjectDef.label: Mugirl advanced gear
ResearchProjectDef.description: Adapt spacer-grade equipment for Mugirl use: powered armor, spacesuits, mechanitor backpacks and tactical optics.

ResearchProjectDef.label: Mugirl firearms
ResearchProjectDef.description: Set up workshop lines for Mugirl-pattern and captured PMC/OPC firearms, from blowback pistols to precision rifles.
